description: Western North America soil-moisture sampling lattice: the 397 cells of the reviewed North America 1-degree lattice inside N51/W-125/S31/E-104 that ERA5-Land models. This plan exists to establish the analysis spatial cells that ERA5-Land persistence requires, using the canonical cell geometry. It is a superset of the four-cell Pacific Northwest probe lattice and reuses its cell keys verbatim, so both remain idempotent. CONTINUATION 2026-08-08, split B (radiation only): ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN under NASA POWER community=AG (the community this codebase's fetcher actually requests, per nasa_power_daily_url) has a measured ~2-month publication lag, confirmed identical across 10 cells spread over the lattice: real through 2026-05-31, gap 2026-06-01 onward as of 2026-08-08. This is far longer than the community=RE figure an ad-hoc probe would suggest -- community is load-bearing for this parameter's latency and must not be assumed from a different community's measurement.
